LanguageData.MXNL_NeiyuShield.label: <color=#79CBFF>Guarding Ward</color>
LanguageData.MXNL_NeiyuShield.description: Stage I blocks one attack and enters Stage II; a lethal attack triggers Stage III directly. Stage II has 48 charges. Each hit consumes 1 charge per 36 damage, rounded up, with a minimum of 1. Returns to Stage I after 60 seconds without losing charges. Depleting the shield triggers Stage III. Stage III absorbs damage for 10 seconds, then grants buffs based on the amount absorbed for 40 seconds. High-absorption bonuses stack up to 5 times. Afterwards, weakness lasts 150 seconds: Stage II has only 24 charges and cannot block when empty or trigger Stage III.
